thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty ALERT PDR-9881 fired for gpu-prod-east3 - metric: gpu_mem_pressure_cuda_alloc_fail (5m avg) exceeded critical threshold. Link: https://pagerduty.internal/pdr/PDR-9881

liam_oncall: ack @incident-bot — I'm taking this. pulling telemetry + recent deploy logs.

nina_sre: joining. I see a sudden spike in kvcache size + a pattern of long-running pinned tensors in pod inference-runner-7. GPU free segments fragmented, causing repeated cudaMalloc failures.

liam_oncall: noisy customer reports: nova-ai seeing ~15% 500s on /v1/stream at 2026-03-20T11:04Z. tagging @karim_support to notify account team.

karim_support: calling out to Nova account team now. drafting a brief: "We are mitigating a GPU memory pressure event in east3; some requests may see increased errors or retries. No data loss expected." will send once we have mitigation confirmed.

nina_sre: posting short log snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T11:02:09Z] inferer: batch_size=512 -> cudaMalloc(8192M) failed: out_of_memory
[2026-03-20T11:02:10Z] runtime: kvcache: total_size=18.3GB, entries=246k, prefetch_rate=180/s
[2026-03-20T11:02:11Z] kubelet: pod inference-runner-7 OOM warning: pinned pages high
```

liam_oncall: immediate mitigations I'm applying: 1) emergency route-level concurrency cap for /v1/stream 2) scale out to fallback pool east3-burst with smaller instance sizes 3) force kvcache compaction. executing step 1 now.

ops-bot: runbook action triggered by liam_oncall: `routectl set-concurrency --route /v1/stream --concurrency 6 --region east3` — success.

nina_sre: initiating kvcache compact and expire:
```
kubectl -n inference exec kvcache-manager -- kvcachectl compact --max-size 12GB && kvcachectl expire --ttl 300
```
Output: compacted to 12.1GB, expired ~22k keys (~1.1GB freed)

liam_oncall: scale command to bring up 6 nodes in east3-burst (smaller GPUs) to take spillover traffic. If scale fails, we'll evacuate heavy workers.

ops-bot: autoscaler request sent: scale gpu-pool-east3-burst +6 nodes — provisioning in progress.

nina_sre: note: one of the failed pods shows cublasStatusAllocFailed and then long-running pinned allocations from a single model shard; moving that model off the largest batch routes will help. Opening a quick ticket.

liam_oncall: temporary config tweak: set default max_batch_size=128 for model X on east3. ops-bot applying.

ops-bot: config update: `modelctl patch X --region east3 --max-batch 128` — applied.

karim_support: sent initial advisory to Nova: short message + mitigation steps. they asked for ETA; told them we'll update in 15m.

nina_sre: after kvcache compact + pod migration, observed cudaAlloc errors drop by ~70% on affected nodes; some residual fragmentation remains. GPU free memory per node now ~28-34%. p95 latency slightly elevated while spillover nodes warm.

liam_oncall: plan for next hour: 1) monitor for 20m stable window, 2) run allocator telemetry collection (trace alloc/free histograms), 3) schedule offline analysis ticket for model memory patterns + kvcache guardrails. Please leave notes for on-call handoff.

nina_sre: creating infra ticket INF-4127: "allocator histograms + kvcache high-water guard" and linking logs. assigning to allocator team.

liam_oncall: paging policy note: if cudaAlloc failures >3/min for 5 minutes, escalate to infra-lead and trigger multi-region failover playbook.

pagerduty-bot: PDR-9881 status=acknowledged by liam_oncall at 2026-03-20T11:08:24Z

karim_support: customer update queued once we hit 20m stable. Nova acknowledged and appreciated proactive notice.

nina_sre: followup quick action: disabled aggressive prefetch on model X in east3 to reduce churn: `modelctl set-prefetch X --region east3 --window 3` — result: OK. observing lower prefetch spikes.

ops-bot: last_message_ts updated to 3520001560 — thread will remain open until manual close.

liam_oncall: handing off if stable at 11:30Z to next oncall @nina_sre. I'll leave the runbook steps in the incident tracker: https://incidents.internal/9881. Thanks all. :heart:
